name: spatial-elements
description: A framework for spatial immersive content experiences.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @spatial-elements/core && npm run build -w @spatial-elements/sveltekit
scripts.check: npm run check:layout && npm run build && npm run check --workspaces
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n core,sveltekit "npm run dev -w @spatial-elements/core" "npm run dev -w @spatial-elements/sveltekit"
scripts.verify: npm run check:ci && npm run check:docs && npm run check:format && npm run check:release && npm run test:release && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check && npm test && npm run verify:packages
scripts.profile:demo: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node scripts/profile-demo.mjs
scripts.release:version: changeset version && node scripts/sync-release.mjs && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build:apps: npm run build && npm run build:demo && npm run build:tests && npm run build -w @spatial-elements/website
scripts.dev:demo: npm run build && node scripts/sync-demo-assets.mjs && npm run dev -w @spatial-elements/demo
scripts.dev:tests: npm run build && node scripts/sync-demo-assets.mjs && npm run dev -w @spatial-elements/tests
scripts.dev:website: npm run build && node scripts/sync-demo-assets.mjs && npm run dev -w @spatial-elements/website
scripts.build:website: npm run build && node scripts/sync-demo-assets.mjs && npm run build -w @spatial-elements/website
